cases.title: Add new bookmark
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark can be successfully added.

cases.title: Add bookmark to a specific location
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark is added into a specific location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Delete Bookmark from File and Access Points
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark is properly deleted from the bookmarks file and is no longer displayed from all access points.

cases.title: Add Bookmark to Personal Toolbar
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be successfully added to the personal toolbar.

cases.title: Delete Bookmark from Personal Toolbar
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be successfully deleted from the personal toolbar.

cases.title: Insert new bookmark folder into hierarchy
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark folder is successfully inserted into the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Double-click bookmark to launch in browser window
cases.description: Verify that double-clicking on a bookmark causes it to be launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Verify default bookmarks are valid links
cases.description: Verify that all bookmarks within the default bookmarks file that is packaged with the browser contain valid links.

cases.title: Save changes to bookmark item without integrity loss
cases.description: Verify that changes made to a bookmark item are successfully saved without any loss of item integrity.

cases.title: Delete Bookmarks Folder
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks folder is successfully deleted.

cases.title: Add bookmarks separator
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks separator can be added successfully.

cases.title: Delete bookmarks separator
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks separator can be deleted successfully.

cases.title: Bookmark Changes Persistence Over Restart and Crash
cases.description: Verify that bookmark changes are successfully saved and persist over browser restart or crash.

cases.title: Verify Negative View Properties Execution
cases.description: Verify that view properties execute negatively for bookmarks, folders, and separators.

cases.title: Inline Renaming of Bookmarks
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be renamed inline directly without having to use the bookmarks properties dialog.

cases.title: Find Bookmark Using Custom Keyword
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be successfully found using a user-defined custom keyword.

cases.title: Sort Bookmarks Per Column
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks are sorted correctly per column.

cases.title: Reverse-Sort Bookmarks Per Column
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks are reverse-sorted correctly per column.

cases.title: Resize Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be resized to show or hide more of entries.

cases.title: Show Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be explicitly shown.

cases.title: Hide Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be explicitly hidden.

cases.title: Delete Several Bookmarks at One Time
cases.description: Verify that several bookmarks can be selected and deleted simultaneously in a single action.

cases.title: Prevent Dropping Bookmark Onto Itself
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto itself.

cases.title: Prevent Dropping Bookmark Onto Immediate Parent
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto its immediate parent.

cases.title: Prevent Dropping Bookmark Onto Immediate Child
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto its immediate child.

opinions.feedback: All requirements and their corresponding normal, edge, boundary, and abnormal/error behaviors are fully covered by the distinct test cases provided. There are no missing scenarios or confirmed blockers.

All requirements and their corresponding test cases have been thoroughly reviewed. The proposed test cases adequately cover the normal paths, boundaries, and negative states specified in the requirements without any confirmed blockers or missing coverage gaps.

analysis.analysis: R-001 contains multiple distinct behaviors: adding a new bookmark and placing it into a specific location within the hierarchy. R-002 contains multiple distinct behaviors: deleting bookmarks from the bookmarks file and removing them from all access points. R-003 contains multiple distinct behaviors: adding bookmarks to the personal toolbar and deleting bookmarks from the personal toolbar. R-004 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion for inserting a new bookmark folder into the hierarchy, warranting only a single Normal test scenario. R-005 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion where double-clicking a bookmark launches it in a browser window. R-006 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion that packaged default bookmarks are valid links. R-007 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion that bookmark changes are saved without item integrity loss. R-008 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion for deleting a bookmarks folder. R-009 contains multiple distinct behaviors: adding bookmarks separators and deleting bookmarks separators. R-010 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion that bookmark changes persist over browser restart or crash. R-011 specifies a negative scenario explicitly for view properties executing for bookmarks, folders, and separators, warranting Abnormal/Error scenarios. R-012 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion for inline renaming of bookmarks. R-013 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion for finding bookmarks via user-defined custom keywords. R-014 contains multiple distinct behaviors: sorting bookmarks per column and reverse-sorting bookmarks per column. R-015 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion for resizing bookmark columns to show or hide entries. R-016 contains multiple distinct behaviors: showing bookmark columns and hiding bookmark columns. R-017 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion for deleting multiple bookmarks at one time. R-018 specifies constraints preventing dropping a bookmark onto itself or its immediate parent or child, explicitly defining boundary or error conditions warranting Abnormal/Error and Boundary scenarios.
